primitive.relation: one contract, an induced (chordless) vertex-sequence path: a duplicate-free sequence following host edges in which every host edge between two of its entries joins consecutive entries (seq_consecutive); five views differ only in what they say about the ends and the length. GTBase.induced_paths.induced_path (empty allowed) is Chromatic.X3.x3_induced_path by conversion; nonempty_induced_path is GTMisc.X91.x91_induced_path by conversion; induced_path_between a b p (nonempty, endpoint inclusive, the canonical full-endpoint formula) is Extremal.X98.x98_induced_path_between and GTMisc.X114.x114_induced_path_between by conversion and Packing.U9.is_induced_path (Boolean spath/uniq/index consec) by an explicit iff whose index bridge needs the membership and uniqueness premises; long_induced_path_between adds the X67 clause 3 <= size p in its position and is Minor.X67.x67_induced_path_between by conversion; has_induced_path_of_order t (some nonempty induced path has exactly t vertices) is GTMisc.X208.x208_induced_path_order by an explicit iff through the nth index bridge on the duplicate-free list (false at 0, true at 1 iff the graph has a vertex). The public source GTBase.induced_subdivisions.induced_subdivision (C20, pinned 97605dd) keeps its body inhabited (induced_subdivision_model H G); only the Record's pattern-edge field isd_edge_path_valid is now written through induced_path_between, which unfolds to exactly the former inline match (definitional equality, no proof irrelevance); the complete seven-field C20 Record is frozen with cancelling field-by-field transports and the wrapper iff. Chromatic.X177.x177_induced_path_between shares the normalized name but is a different, defective contract (tail-list simple path with a documented tautological chord clause; its lantern row is blocked): deferred-excluded, unchanged, not redirected. Distinct and untouched: X218's induced run, induced cycles and holes, upstream upath/IPath.

empty-allowed-bare-list.note: [/\ uniq p, sorted adjacency & no chord] with the empty sequence allowed; X3's uniquely-covered path row and X83's rainbow row are frozen over it.

nonempty-bare-list.note: nonempty duplicate-free adjacency path with no chord; X91's Pk-free / avoidable-path row is frozen over it.

full-endpoint-list.note: nonempty full list from a to b with no chord: X98 and X114 by conversion (the C20 Record field formula), U9's Boolean spath/consec encoding by the explicit iff is_induced_path_compat (index bridge with membership and uniqueness premises; spath and consec stay live).

full-endpoint-list-at-least-three.note: the full-endpoint view with the 3 <= size p clause kept in X67's position; theta and the solved treewidth row are frozen over it.

exact-order-existence.note: some nonempty induced path with exactly t vertices; X208's index encoding (non-consecutive positions not adjacent) is bridged by chordless_nthP on the duplicate-free list; the existential head vertex is the list's head, no hidden default-vertex premise.

public-model-wrapper.note: C20's public inhabited wrapper (pinned 97605dd) over the seven-field Record whose pattern-edge field is now the canonical induced_path_between; the complete Record is frozen verbatim, transported field by field in both directions with cancellation, and the wrapper iff is certified; constructor, projections and Arguments unchanged.

distinct-defective-tail-path.verdict: distinct representation: tail-list simple path with a documented tautological chord clause, not chordless-path vocabulary
distinct-defective-tail-path.note: Chromatic.X177.x177_induced_path_between keeps its defective body unchanged; the lantern/pervasive row is already blocked; nothing is repaired or redirected here.

upstream_audit.note: coq-graph-theory 0.9.7 has upath / IPath (irredundant walks; chords are allowed) and sgraph.induced_path (a transport lemma for paths of an induced subgraph), no chordless-path predicate; GTBase.walks_paths supplies seq_consecutive with its infix / zip reflections, seq_simple_walk and the path-vertex API. The canonical views are therefore new in GTBase.induced_paths over path, uniq and seq_consecutive, bridged to index encodings by infix_pair_index / index_pair_infix / seq_consecutive_index / chordless_nthP.
